title: vsync present and first frame fence

commit.merge_subject: merge: vsync present and first frame fence

description:
The white-window round 5 probe extension (the brief's commit 2 —
free, debug-only). The probe's pixel line used to fire on the FIRST
frame per attach per develop resolution only — exactly the window
the decoded mechanism lives in (the owner's center-then-whole clue:
the FIRST present after an eligibility flip is broken, subsequent
presents converge), but one line cannot show the convergence. The
latch now fires TWICE per attach/resolution: the first frame AND the
frame after the next swap, labeled shot=1 / shot=2 on the line — so
the device replay shows BOTH the first frame's rgb AND the second
frame's rgb. The mechanism's on-device signature is a white/partial
shot 1 with a colored shot 2; with the round-5 fix in, BOTH shots
should read real color from the first visible frame.

Design: a probeSecondShot GL-thread latch joins the existing
probeW/H ladder — the first line of a resolution
changed: fix: vsync-aligned present and first-frame fence
